_comment: NightMode. enabled: true/false. default: when APs that are in none of the groups below are off. groups: per UniFi AP Group, when its APs are off (off_from/off_until in 24h local NAS time "HH:MM", may cross midnight), or "off": "never". An AP in several groups follows the one that keeps it on longest. ignore: AP names or MACs the script never touches.
